sentences.text:
Dated : 06-11-2025  Shri R.P.Yadav - Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri Ajay Shukla - Public Prosecutor for the respond Heard on I.A.No.14247/2025, which is first application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail on behalf of appellant/Udba @ Lala @ Ajay Saket.

This appeal is filed by appellant being aggrieved of judgment dated 22/03/2025 passed in SCATR No.20/2023 by the Special Judge [SC & ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act], Sidhi whereby he has been convicted for offences under Section 342 of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 01 year; and Section 376-D of IPC & sentenced for Life Imprisonment for remaining natural life with fine of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulations.

entities.text: Special Judge [SC & ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act], Sidhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that appellant is innocent.
There are general and omnibus allegations against the appellant.
DNA report Exhibit-P/28 is negative qua present appellant.
There are good chances of success in appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.
Shri Ajay Shukla, learned Government Advocate supports the impugned judgment and opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the fact 2 CRA-5676-2025 that there appears to be good chances of success in appeal, without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of jail sentence of appellant-Udba @ Lala @ Ajay Saket and release him on bail.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount Udba @ Lala @ Ajay Saket vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118105679/
1 to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court 19.12.2025 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of appellant-Udba @ Lala @ Ajay Saket shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
C.C. as per rules.
